question_text: Why is the sympathetic division called thoraco-lumbar division?

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Where the nerves arise
steps.why: Divisions of the autonomic system are named after the part of the cord their nerves leave from.
common_mistakes: Naming the brain as the origin. That is the parasympathetic division.
steps.memory_tip: Thoracic and lumbar: the middle of the cord.
steps.margin_note: Name the two regions, then draw the conclusion.
lines: In the sympathetic division of the
nerves arise from the thoracic and lumbar

steps.label: Why the name
steps.why: The two region names put together give the division its second name.
common_mistakes: Stopping before saying why the name follows.
Calling it the cranio-sacral division. That is the parasympathetic one.

lines.text: So it is called the thoraco-lumbar division

insider_note: The name comes from a place, so the answer must name the two regions of the spinal cord. Nothing else earns the mark.
